content: प्रणीत {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} .²1 Put forward, advanced, presented. .²2 Delivered, given, offered, presented. .²3 Brought into, reduced to. .²4 Executed, effected, performed. .²5 Taught, prescribed. .²6 Cast, sent, discharged. .²7 Brought to, set. .²8 Written, composed. .²9 Set aside, removed. .²10 Agreeable or pleasing. .²11 Inflicted (as punishment); see प्रणी above. .{@-तः@} Fire consecrated by prayers. .{@-ता@} A sacrificed vessel. .{@-तम्@} Anything cooked or dressed, such as a condiment.
